title: 도시철도법 등에 의한 구분지상권 등기규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe special provisions on real estate registration pursuant to Article 12 (3) of the Urban Railroad Act; Article 28 (5) of the Road Act; Article 89-2 (3) of the Electric Utility Act; Article 110-3 (3) of the Rearrangement of Agricultural and Fishing Villages Act; Article 12-3 (3) of the Act on the Construction of Railroads and Maintenance of Railroad Facilities; Article 28 (4) of the Regional Development and Support Act; Article 60-3 (3) of the Water Supply and Waterworks Installation Act; Article 6-4 (3) of the Electric Power Source Development Promotion Act; and Article 10-3 (3) of the Sewerage Act. <Amended on July 26, 2004; September 28, 2009; February 2, 2017; January 9, 2019; and October 29, 2021.>
